purpose: Bounded source-status and theorem-scope verification, not an exhaustive literature review.
hash_definition: SHA-256 of exact retrieved original response bytes. Hashes are omitted rather than invented when only a text view was inspected.

sources.title: The Open Problems Project, Problem 16: Simple Polygonalizations
sources.inspection_limits: Full short entry, bibliography, current open label and revision history inspected. This is maintained status evidence, not a proof of worldwide openness.

sources.title: Peeling and Nibbling the Cactus: Subexponential-Time Algorithms for Counting Triangulations and Related Problems
sources.inspection_limits: Conference version: introduction, assumptions, Theorems 1, 3 and 6, and section 6 inspected. Extended abstract; complete correctness and bit complexity not audited.

sources.title: Peeling and Nibbling the Cactus: Subexponential-Time Algorithms for Counting Triangulations and Related Problems, full version
sources.inspection_limits: Header identifies arXiv:1603.07340v1. Introductory assumptions, annotation theorem, Theorem 8 and its application proof, and closing scope/geometry remarks inspected. Requires no three collinear and no four cocircular points. Full 47-page proof not independently audited.

sources.title: Counting and Enumerating Crossing-free Geometric Graphs
sources.inspection_limits: Header identifies arXiv:1604.05350v1 and embedded manuscript date June 26, 2018. Abstract, general-position assumption and Theorem 7/algorithm interpretation inspected. Complete combination-graph proof not audited.

sources.title: Non-crossing Hamiltonian Paths and Cycles in Output-Polynomial Time, earlier preprint
sources.inspection_limits: Header identifies arXiv:2303.00147v1, 1 March 2023. Abstract, definitions, selected hull-order/counting passages and conclusion inspected. This earlier conclusion does not contain all questions in the journal conclusion.

sources.title: Non-crossing Hamiltonian Paths and Cycles in Output-Polynomial Time, Algorithmica 2024
sources.inspection_limits: Journal HTML abstract, introduction, polygon definitions, hull observations and section 6 inspected. Explicit #P and parameterized-complexity questions verified here. Whole article proof not independently audited.

sources.title: Counting Polygon Triangulations is Hard
sources.inspection_limits: Header identifies v2, 20 March 2020. Theorem 1, polygon-with-holes definitions and section 5 inspected. The result is #P-completeness under Turing reductions for polygons with holes, not unrestricted point-set triangulations or polygonalizations.

sources.title: Generating random simple polygons
sources.inspection_limits: Short historical question inspected for target overlap only; not relied on for current complexity status or extremal constants.

sources.title: Enumerating Non-Crossing Hamiltonian Paths by Reachability Checks and Bidirectional Search
sources.inspection_limits: Text extraction of PDF pages 42–47 inspected for title, abstract, method scope and experiments. Whole booklet/full subsequent manuscript not audited. Original PDF bytes not retained, so no file hash is claimed.

sources.title: On the Number of Drawings of a Combinatorial Triangulation
sources.inspection_limits: Publisher HTML abstract, definitions and listed main results inspected. Scope is embeddings of a fixed triangulation, not general exact polygonalization counting. Original response bytes not retained; no file hash claimed.
